answer.justification: The space posterior to the stomach is the lesser sac (omental bursa). The gastrohepatic ligament (lesser omentum) forms its anterior boundary. Dividing this ligament allows entry into the lesser sac to access the pancreatic tumor. The other ligaments are not involved in accessing this space.
